base2_ith_mech_2x.why: 6 Scythers, all fast melee, from the south. Dead-end room behind one door at the top of a 1-wide corridor (x 133, z 179-186): raiders reach us only through the doorway or along the corridor axis, one at a time, while every gun 2+ cells back covers the doorway. The plug and both diagonals stop a Scyther from stepping past the plug into the room.
